title: College Friends Ep 01
desc: College Friends’ brings that feeling back—louder, funnier, and messier than ever. It’s a story of 7 friends navigating the rollercoaster of college life, filled with chaos, crushes, confusion, and moments that stay with you forever. Whether you’re still in college or have left those days behind, this series is a nostalgic, heartfelt trip back to where it all began.
